points.description: First advantage: multiples valuation is quick, simple or convenient to use (easy/fast to apply).
points.partial_credit: Half if only loosely related (e.g. cheap or easy to understand) without clear speed/simplicity idea.

points.description: Second advantage: it uses market-based data that reflects the market's expectations of growth and risk (market-reflective, current market pricing).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says 'based on market data' or 'reflects the market' without growth/risk idea.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating both ideas in any wording: quick/convenient/easy, and based on market data reflecting market expectations. Accept the two advantages in either order. Give part marks for vague but related answers; give 0 for a blank or unrelated answer. Extra wrong remarks do not cost marks.
